english.html: cide may produce his own brother against the fisc [the royal treasury], or the King, who alone is the party against him, to show that he committed the killing in defending himself <sup class="mk" data-key="f">f</sup>: for although the King pursues the confiscation of the accused's goods, nevertheless such a penal and odious gain, which cannot come about except with the detriment and loss both of the honour and of the life of the accused, does not come into consideration. <sup class="mk" data-key="g">g</sup>

notes.citation: Baldus (Balde) on Code 4.20 (De testibus), l. Parentes, cited above at {a}

notes.gloss: Baldus's exception admitting a kinsman where the fisc alone is the adversary.

english.html: In the second place, there are witnesses who were at the wedding of the said Martin and de Rols, and especially one Catherine Boëre, who brought at midnight the collation (which they called the réveil [the midnight visit to the bridal bed with food and drink]), who obstinately assures that it is he who married the said de Rols, and whom she found lying in bed with her. Thirdly, the better part of the witnesses give marks and conjectures that are invincible, to wit, that Martin Guerre had two supernumerary teeth in the upper jaw, a scar on the forehead, the nail of the first finger sunken, three warts on the right hand, another on the little finger, and a drop of blood in the left eye; which marks have all been found on the prisoner.

This puts me in mind of Quintus Fabius Maximus, who, inasmuch as he was full of little swellings of flesh raised upon the skin of the body (called by the French, in imitation of the Latin, verrues, warts), up to about the breast, was called by the Romans VERRUCOSUS,
